_comment: Offline demo fixture (NOT an AssemblyAI output captured by us): a synthetic meeting transcript in the AssemblyAI transcript JSON shape (utterances with speaker labels + auto chapters). Used only when ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is unset, so the extraction/minutes pipeline can be evaluated end-to-end without an API key. With a key set, real audio is transcribed by AssemblyAI and this file is never read.
